title: Count with an atomic increment
summary: INCR adds one to a key holding an integer.
introduction: INCR adds one to a key holding an integer. Your task: Add one more INCR and predict the value.
learningObjectives: Add one more INCR and predict the value.
Explain the example for count with an atomic increment

blocks.text: INCR adds one to a key holding an integer. Redis performs that increment as one command.
Use a local Redis server and redis-cli. Commands here use cma: practice keys only. Redis commands do not run in the site's SQLite playground. Do not connect these exercises to a production database.

blocks.code:
SET cma:books 0
INCR cma:books
INCR cma:books
GET cma:books

items: `INCR` adds one to an integer string value as a single Redis operation.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: INCR expects an integer value. A key holding a word cannot be incremented as a number.

blocks.text: Add one more INCR and predict the value.
